prompt: An antique Chinese pilgrim's map of the long road to the West, painted on an aged, stained silk scroll: misty blue-green mountain ranges, winding rivers, tiny pagodas, temples and walled towns, auspicious clouds and a small dragon at the margins, all in faded ink and soft mineral washes of azurite, malachite, cinnabar and gold. The centre is mostly open plain and mist with very few marks so game icons can sit on top. Made by hand like a 1993 fantasy game-book illustration: bold, wobbly black pen-and-ink outlines, thin flat transparent watercolour washes with blotchy hard edges, a little cross-hatching, rough off-white paper grain showing through; Chinese, Ming dynasty, Journey to the West; bright and colourful (cinnabar, azurite, malachite, gold, peach pink) rather than muddy. No Japanese elements. No text, no characters, no seals with writing.
